bibliographic.title: Max's Adventure
bibliographic.author: EC Holm
bibliographic.description:
Updated 4/19/2020

You are an artificial intelligence with a body. You have to figure out what works, where you are, what situation you are in. And yes, you probably don't have a lot of time.

This is an interactive novel in the Science Fiction genre. It features math puzzles.

Created in Twine/SugarCube 2.2.1
*Note* This game is not complete. It is still under construction.

Change log:

Fixed the third puzzle.
Added inventory.
Added new items.
Added some interaction with characters.
Corrected some writing.
Made a workaround for the bug.

Download instructions: Click on the link and download the file to your device (PC, Mac, smartphone, tablet, etc). This game runs on a browser. All files are run and saved locally.
